So far, nine feature flows are settled:

- Saving links with editable fetched details and optional imagery
- Duplicate prevention across the library and Archive
- Search across titles, descriptions, notes, and addresses
- Tag assignment, suggestions, cleanup, and filtering
- Read-later marking and its dedicated view
- Formatted personal notes
- Reversible archiving and restoration
- Deliberate permanent deletion
- Clear handling of empty, invalid, unreachable, long-content, and changing-page cases

All 14 approved behavior scenarios are recorded, and the main interactions are settled. May I start implementing this scope?
